usage: code-review-graph daemon [-h]
                                {start,stop,restart,status,logs,add,remove}
                                ...

positional arguments:
  {start,stop,restart,status,logs,add,remove}
    start               Start the watch daemon
    stop                Stop the watch daemon
    restart             Restart the watch daemon
    status              Show daemon and watcher status
    logs                View daemon or watcher logs
    add                 Add a repo to the watch config
    remove              Remove a repo from the watch config

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
start:
usage: code-review-graph daemon start [-h] [--foreground]

options:
  -h, --help    show this help message and exit
  --foreground  Run in the foreground instead of in the background
stop:
usage: code-review-graph daemon stop [-h]

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
restart:
usage: code-review-graph daemon restart [-h] [--foreground]

options:
  -h, --help    show this help message and exit
  --foreground  Run in the foreground instead of in the background
status:
usage: code-review-graph daemon status [-h]

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
logs:
usage: code-review-graph daemon logs [-h] [--repo REPO] [--follow]
                                     [--lines LINES]

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --repo REPO    Show logs for a specific repo alias
  --follow       Follow log output (tail -f)
  --lines LINES  Number of lines to show (default: 50)
add:
usage: code-review-graph daemon add [-h] [--alias ALIAS] path

positional arguments:
  path           Path to the repository

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --alias ALIAS  Short alias for the repo
remove:
usage: code-review-graph daemon remove [-h] path_or_alias

positional arguments:
  path_or_alias  Repository path or alias to remove

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
